items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 153:1
items.html: (To the question) The first way is that Aba and YESHSUT are made one, and Ima and Tevuna are made one, as above (page 946, Item 150). The second way is that the upper AVI are both made into the Partzuf of Aba, and YESHSUT are made into the Partzuf of Ima, and they both couple in an equal stature, as said (in Etz Chaim, Gate 19, end of Chapter 8). The third way is that Tevuna ascends above, to the place of the upper Ima, and the coupling of Aba is made with Tevuna and not with the upper Ima (as said in Etz Chaim, Gate 14, Chapter 8, and in Gate 4, Chapter 3). And one must always ponder, regarding the joining of AVI and YESHSUT, all these three ways mentioned above. And they also apply to the joining of Leah and Rachel into one Partzuf (as said below, in Answer 284, p. 792, Sub Header “And from the beginning”).
